articles.title: LVMH to sell Marc Jacobs to joint venture in $850 mln deal
articles.summary:
STORY: French luxury group LVMH has agreed to sell fashion brand Marc Jacobs to a joint venture. 

Buyers WHP Global and G-III Apparel Group said they’re raising up to $850 million to fund the deal.

Marc Jacobs' sale closes a nearly three-decade chapter for LVMH.

It reflects a broader push to focus on profitability in the challenging luxury market.

That’s as the Middle East conflict continues to disrupt travel and weighs on spending in a key region.

LVMH said last month the Iran war shaved at least 1% off group sales in the latest quarter.

Brand manager WHP Global said Marc Jacobs would become a core part of its premium fashion portfolio, which already includes Vera Wang, rag & bone and G-STAR.

The acquisition will take the company’s global retail sales above $9.5 billion.  

:: La Biennale di Venezia/Rai

Founder Marc Jacobs, who launched the label in 1984, will remain creative director after the deal closes, overseeing its creative direction and runway collections.
